title: Implementation notes — Milestone 2A teach and exact routing corrections
subtitle: implementation complete · 2026-09-18
intro: Each item is a decision, deviation, or tradeoff made during implementation. Acknowledge if fine. Discuss to write what should change. Revert to flag for undo.

groups.label: Phase 1 — secure feedback and receipt storage

body.Spec said: Route receipts must be bounded, without selecting a count.
body.What I did: Keep the newest 100 receipts in the private state file.
body.Why: This is enough recent history for correction workflows while keeping every rewrite small.

body.What I did: Disabled bytecode writes while the isolated evaluator imports a candidate router and while the research test gate runs, with regression coverage for both paths.
body.Why: The first full-suite run created an untracked __pycache__ inside a temporary research worktree, which the patch allowlist rejected.
body.Result: Evaluation no longer dirties the candidate worktree, and the patch allowlist remains strict.

items.title: Use the discovery-compatible fallback project identity

body.Spec said: Resolve taught targets by stable project identity and canonical path.
body.What I did: Made the fallback identity use the same deterministic 16-character SHA-256 value as project discovery.
body.Why: A correction captured from a project mapping without an explicit ID now resolves identically when the live catalog supplies its discovery ID.

items.title: Apply exact corrections before the heuristic word-count guard

body.Spec said: Resolve taught fingerprints after direct selectors but before route_task.
body.What I did: Exact taught corrections now work for one-word tasks; untaught one-word selectors still fail before heuristic routing.
body.Why: The teach command accepts any nonempty task, so every recorded exact correction must be reachable.

body.Spec said: Feedback writes are atomic and corrections remain append-only events.
body.What I did: Each locked teach or revoke now atomically replaces the JSONL file with the complete prior history plus one new event.
body.Why: A failed write cannot leave a partial record that makes all private feedback unreadable.

body.Result: Secure feedback storage, exact correction routing, route receipts, and the teach/list/show/revoke CLI are implemented and verified.
